description: The main branch deploys to nothing by default: clusters follow the stable branch, which only the promote workflow moves, after a 7-day soak, a security gate and the owner's approval. That is why the 1-day cooldown and the automerge of leaf apps are safe: they decide what enters main, not what a cluster runs. The cooldown limits PR churn from chart repositories that publish several releases a day. The soak of stable covers cluster exposure. The required checks gate every merge. Leaf apps (Headlamp, kube-prometheus-stack, Loki, Alloy, helper images) automerge patch and minor updates once checks pass. Cluster-wide components (Argo CD, Cilium, cert-manager, external-secrets, external-dns, storage drivers, cloud controllers, autoscaler, Traefik, RKE2 and the kind node) are merged by hand, because a bad update can break networking, storage or Argo CD itself. Major updates are reviewed by hand.

kubernetes.description: Plain, non-templated manifests carrying a container image. Scoped deliberately: everything else under platform/ is a Helm template, which this manager cannot parse.

packageRules.description: RKE2 tags are semver plus an RKE2 build counter (v1.36.2+rke2r1), which no built-in versioning scheme parses.

Pin the wildcard subchart ranges in Chart.yaml. A '2.*' range is never out of date, so Renovate can only begin tracking these once they resolve to an exact version - which also matches how every other chart version in this repo is pinned.
kind releases are built for specific node images, so the two move together.
Cluster-wide components: a bad update can take down networking, storage or Argo CD, so a person merges each one.

bootstrap/rendered holds the Argo CD and Cilium manifests that make boot-renders produces from these two chart versions, and CI fails if they differ. Renovate renders them again in the same branch. The helm version matches the one in the kube-devenv image. The runner must allow both commands (RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS in bbaliyan/renovate-config).
The promote workflow can move stable and holds the deploy key. A person reads every change to it, its scripts and its pinned packages.

pip-compile.description: The hash-pinned Python packages that the promote workflow installs (ci/requirements-promote.in compiles to the .txt).
